questions.question: Where can you safely read which user just logged out inside a wp_logout callback?

options.label: The $user_id argument passed to the callback

feedback.correct: Yes. The session is already destroyed by the time wp_logout fires — use the $user_id argument WordPress passes in.
feedback.incorrect: wp_get_current_user() no longer works — the session is already gone. Use the $user_id argument passed directly to your wp_logout callback.
